task: Fix pre-showing 12.4% similarity scores, isolate per-proposal scan results, fix clunky date wrapping on matched archive manuscripts, and integrate archive inspect modal
rootCausesIdentified: CreateProjectPage.jsx had hardcoded fallback to 12.4% on unscanned proposals and hardcoded metrics of 4.2% (winnowing) and 14.8% (semantic).
Matched Archive Manuscripts mapped over a static hardcoded array of 2 dummy entries before any scan was triggered.
The academic year Badge inside Matched Archive Manuscripts was compressed by flex layout alongside long titles without shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap, causing '2024–2025' to wrap awkwardly onto 2 lines.
Proposals did not isolate scan results cleanly, causing identical scores across tabs.

modifications.summary: Replaced hardcoded 12.4% with dynamic 0.0% unscanned state; added per-proposal scan isolation; added empty state for unscanned manuscripts and no-matches state; styled date badge with 'shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap font-mono' to eliminate 2-line wrapping; integrated SimilarProjectModal on Inspect click; fixed duplicate 'match' text string.
Selected academicYear, abstract, targetBeneficiary, techStack, and createdAt; computed dynamic winnowing and semantic scores; standardized academicYear formatting.
Added 3 comprehensive unit tests asserting 0.0% unscanned defaults, dynamic scan execution with non-wrapping badges and modal inspect, and per-proposal scan isolation (10/10 tests passed).
Created and executed multi-viewport visual feedback audit (desktop 1440x900, mobile 390x844, light & dark mode) confirming badge height <= 20px with zero line breaks.

verification.visualAudit: scratch/proposal_scan_audit.mjs (100% passed across all 4 viewport/theme matrix passes)

lessonsLearned: Always apply 'shrink-0 whitespace-nowrap' and monospace font formatting on date/year badges when placed inside flexible header containers with potentially long user-generated titles.
Ensure unscanned analysis tabs show informative empty call-to-action states rather than dummy mock data.
When API match labels can contain text units (e.g. 'match'), avoid unconditional suffix concatenation in JSX.
